# Classic Guild Bank

Classic Guild Bank ( [https://classicguildbank.com](https://classicguildbank.com/) ) is a World of Warcraft Classic addon and companion website used for guilds to help manage guild resources and item tracking.

## FAQ

Check out our [FAQ](https://github.com/ClassicGuildBank/ClassicGuildBank/blob/master/FAQ.md) page for help using the addon and website.

results.title: Classic Guild Bank Addon maybe violanting TOS - WoW Classic General Discussion - World of Warcraft Forums
excerpts:
World of Warcraft Forums

# Classic Guild Bank Addon maybe violanting TOS

WoW Classic WoW Classic General Discussion

[Hurzala-ysera](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Hurzala-ysera) September 9, 2019, 4:23pm 1

There’s an addon for classic called - ‘Classic Guild Bank’ that is listed on the curse website. It is a new addon with about 3k downloads right now.

From the curse webpage description -  
…let’s you export inventory from your characters or bank alts to the classicguildbank(DOT)com website…

This addon seems to allow the player to load the data from an item to the outside website, and then make it available to any character, even other players, as in the description it mentions using it as a regular guild bank for multiple people.

Isn’t this a violation of the TOS by exporting the item data to a 3rd party website, and then re-introducing it back into the game.

Have to wonder if this will lead to duping.

PS. found the addon while doing a google search to see if guilds had banks in Classic.

[Rufflebottom-4646](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Rufflebottom-4646) (Rufflebottom) September 9, 2019, 4:26pm 2

Hurzala:

> Have to wonder if this will lead to duping.
> 
>

All it is doing is making spreadsheet data about stuff in the game. It doesn’t move or copy the items to the website. It is not possible to duplicate items just by making a document that lists the items.

4 Likes

[Aurae-23273](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Aurae-23273) (Aurae) September 9, 2019, 4:27pm 3

That’s not how duping works.  
It’s not violating the TOS in any way, similar addons existed in Vanilla.  
No, guild banks did not exist in Vanilla as they currently exist in Retail. Officers had alts used to store items for the guild, which is why such addons existed to track all items.

1 Like

[Glindaril-29979](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Glindaril-29979) (Glindaril) September 9, 2019, 4:27pm 4

The thing about addons is that they run in the API sandbox within the game, using functions allowed by Blizzard. In the event an addon is doing something that it isn’t supposed to, Blizzard will most likely break the functionality.

There are other services that allow you to compare gear and recommend BiS. Those have been around for years and are still going strong.

1 Like

[mattyfresh-20235](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/mattyfresh-20235) (mattyfresh) September 9, 2019, 4:29pm 5

:joy: :joy: :joy: :joy: :joy: that is not how it works at all. all the addon can do is export information about the items. not actual items. lol.

[Ristra-1994741](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Ristra-1994741) (Ristra) September 9, 2019, 4:29pm 6

Hurzala:

> There’s an addon for classic called - ‘Classic Guild Bank’ that is listed on the curse website. It is a new addon with about 3k downloads right now.
> 
> From the curse webpage description -  
> …let’s you export inventory from your characters or bank alts to the classicguildbank(DOT)com website…
> 
> This addon seems to allow the player to load the data from an item to the outside website, and then make it available to any character, even other players, as in the description it mentions using it as a regular guild bank for multiple people.
> 
> Isn’t this a violation of the TOS by exporting the item data to a 3rd party website, and then re-introducing it back into the game.
> 
> Have to wonder if this will lead to duping.
> 
> PS. found the addon while doing a google search to see if guilds had banks in Classic.
> 
>

Nope. Altoholic allows for viewing of inventory when you are not on that character. Been around for years.

[gamesux-20046](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/gamesux-20046) (gamesux) September 9, 2019, 4:31pm 7

It’s not affecting the in game items. It’s just automating a process of keeping a list of items. A player could easily manually keep a spreadsheet of items and share it with his guild. Perhaps, it could be abused to make sales for real life money, but that could happen anyway.

## README.md

# OpenDKP

**Do not redistribute this addon. Post a link to this github page instead**

OpenDKP Support Discord: <https://discord.gg/WguFyYJ>

[OpenDKP](https://www.opendkp.com/) is an open source DKP system used across multiple games. This addon provides you the ability to keep track of your raid attendance in game and providing a helper utility to copy/paste those raid ticks into OpenDKP.

Given the limited capabilities with the WOW Addon system, our early MVP addon will allow you to simply keep track of attendance. Going forward, I'll be looking to add support for loot and other opportunities as I continue to learn LUA.

Huge thanks to the folks over at CEPEG/Alumian as I was able to leverage a lot of examples from their addon.

Functionality:

* /opendkp
* show - Shows the opendkp window

To install:

1. Download this addon
2. Extract it to ../Interface/AddOns/

Author: Moncs
